facts.summary: Closed zilovertamab Phase 3 and Phase 1/2 studies in strategic reprioritization · Phase 3 · zilovertamab in mantle cell lymphoma · not yet approved
facts.indication: relapsed or refractory mantle cell lymphoma

evidence.summary: Oncternal announced a strategic reprioritization based on the rapidly changing commercial landscape for Bruton’s tyrosine kinase inhibitors. Pursuant to the reprioritization, Oncternal will be closing two studies
evidence.program_discontinued: Oncternal will be closing two studies: Study ZILO-301, a randomized, double-blind, placebo-controlled global Phase 3 registrational study evaluating zilovertamab in combination with ibrutinib
